nodes.label: Google Social Login Button Icon
nodes.description: Official Google 'G' logo in the standard four-color scheme. A stylized capital 'G' formed by a segmented arc using Google brand colors: red (#EA4335) at the top, yellow (#FBBC05) at the bottom-left, green (#34A853) at the bottom, and blue (#4285F4) at the right. White center and background. Used for 'Sign in with Google' OAuth login buttons.
